## Hermes
- Loads from a plugin directory carrying `plugin.yaml` + `__init__.py`. Two verified paths (hermes_cli/plugins.py): local dev — copy this directory to `~/.hermes/plugins/teamwork/` (user plugin) or `./.hermes/plugins/teamwork/` with `HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS=1` (project plugin, opt-in) — then `hermes plugins list` should show it; from a Git host — `hermes plugins install owner/repo`, then `hermes plugins enable teamwork` (or pass `--enable` to `install`) to activate it — install alone does not enable a plugin. Hermes has no marketplace file, so there is no registry listing step beyond the two paths above.
- Plugin skills are NOT surfaced in `<available_skills>` (hermes_cli/plugins.py:3334-3337) — they resolve only as an explicit `<plugin>:<skill>` load. Verify with a load, e.g. `load teamwork:bind-build`, never with "list your skills".
- MCP: none shipped.
- Dropped — agents: `build-leader`, `builder`, `code-checker`, `docs-writer`, `fleet-marshal`, `planner`, `planning-leader`, `product-leader`, `review-leader`, `wiring-checker`; hooks: none.
- Command-only skills now model-routable: `bind-build`, `bind-planning`, `bind-product`, `bind-review`, `bind-team`, `build-feature`, `chores-run`, `fleet-bootstrap`, `fleet-connect`, `fork-agent`, `init-repo`, `mobilize-chores`, `sub-agent`, `team-scaffolding` (R-5, #888: `ctx.register_command` carries no invocation-source metadata on Hermes — the plain-skill degradation is the CORRECT terminal fallback here, not a temporary gap).
- Fork skills (their `context` field drops; body runs inline): `build-feature`, `fork-agent`.

## Pi
- Loads via `package.json`'s `"pi"` key (`"skills": ["./skills"]`); install with `pi install <path-to-teamwork> -l` from a checkout — confirm with `pi list`, which shows the install path under `Project packages:`. The `"pi-package"` keyword is added automatically (no extra step); once this package is published, that keyword is what the pi.dev gallery scrapes to list it — there is no separate marketplace file to maintain.
